input.question: What is the broadcast format of WCMA?

documents.text: Public file LMS Webcast Listen Live Website cimafm.com WCMA ( 1600 kHz , is an AM radio station broadcasting a Spanish Tropical format . [ 2 ] Licensed to Bayamón , Puerto Rico , it serves all of Puerto Rico . [ 3 ] The station is currently owned by Aurio A. Matos Barreto . WCMA shares with translator stations W279BU ( 103.7 FM ) in San Juan and W241DE ( 96.1 FM ) , also licensed to Bayamón . WCMA simulcasts on WZCA ( 91.7 FM ) in Quebradillas .
